attention_score: intact last-query attention on matching value position averaged over all evaluation examples
attention_subset: first 16 evaluation examples in generator order
checkpoint_selection: maximum dev accuracy; minimum dev loss; earliest step
intervention: zero one head z at all positions before output projection; leave bias intact
metrics: accuracy, cross entropy, correct-answer probability; paired drops and 2000 paired percentile bootstrap 95% intervals; average-rank Spearman with exact ties and null for constant ranks
pilot_decision: Single candidate reached 100% development accuracy by step 200. Freeze 1000 steps for all final seeds, allowing further optimization without further architecture or hyperparameter search.
